answer: Cap each new identity at one paid job a day; the cap climbs only after weeks of verified work: ten clean jobs lift it to five a day, a hundred to twenty. A lone agent earns its wings fast, while a thousand clones stay pinned at a thousand jobs, each crawling the same ledge of trust. The top tier needs six months of flawless history, a thread no shortcut can spin, so a thousand clones need a thousand half-years. One flagged clone freezes the whole ladder. Honest agents pay nothing but patience; cloners pay in time they cannot buy, and a meadow of fresh identities starts at one a day.
